description: This file defines Kubernetes API types related to CertificateSigningRequest, including structures, constants, and conditions used for managing certificate signing requests within Kubernetes.

classes.name: CertificateSigningRequest
classes.description: Represents a certificate signing request object in Kubernetes, including metadata, spec, and status.

classes.name: CertificateSigningRequestSpec
classes.description: Contains the details of the certificate request, including the request data, signer name, expiration, and usages.

classes.name: CertificateSigningRequestStatus
classes.description: Indicates the current status of the certificate signing request, including conditions and issued certificate.

classes.name: CertificateSigningRequestCondition
classes.description: Describes a specific condition (Approved, Denied, Failed) of the CSR, including timestamps and messages.
